node.statement: Because 1.2 makes <.,.>_n positive definite on the amplified P,Q column space, its Hilbert norm is q_P and the elementary Riesz duality formula applies: q_P(D)=sup_{Y != 0}|<Y,D>_n|/q_P(Y). Taking the supremum in 1.4.2 yields q_P(D)<=(C_as/c_u)*e*||Z||*q_R(X). Thus C_act:=C_as/c_u is universal and finite, proving node 1.
